verdict.rationale: The services page links to an 'Open Data Portal Historic Business License Search'. This suggests the Division publishes its business-license registry data through an open data portal rather than only through scrape-only pages. The evidence is a single link label, though, and it does not confirm bulk download formats, file extracts or update cadence. missing for 10: documented bulk download/extract files (CSV/JSON), dataset catalog and schemas, update frequency, other statistical datasets (e.g. tax or revenue statistics), independent or hands-on confirmation that the data is downloadable without scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
